reviews.title: Great, large ring light with several lighting options
reviews.comment:
Needed a light for my WFH webcam setup since my desk was far from any natural lighting, so I bought this one and it's been great.
The light has three different modes depending on how cool, warm, or neutral you prefer your light. You can try them all to see what looks best on you. Within each mode you can also adjust how bright it is. The controller is easy to use and easy to tuck out of the way when not in use.
The light has a standard screw mount where your camera, or another mount piece can attach to.
Overall a really decent ring light.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Works great, easy to use, no issues. Camera mount is compatible.
reviews.comment:
Works great, easy to use, no issues. Camera mount is compatible. Three light modes. I prefer the "skin tone" mode. I work from home and use this light for video calls and meetings. Having good lighting greatly improves the performance and image quality of your HD video camera.
Model: Webcam Light, Ring Light for Logitech Webcam C920,C922x,C930e
reviews.author: Nathan Keiter

reviews.title: Changes online presence
reviews.comment:
Doing Telehealth all day for the last couple of years, my use of a webcam and my comfort level with one has grown exponentially.  I started paying attention to what I saw when individuals on TV we’re doing besides just their “books by the foot” shelves in the background.  One morning I noticed that there was a reflection of a light in the background of an individual who looked particularly professional on TV.  I started looking and found these light rings.  It has made essentially the same difference that going from SD to HD did.  I could not be more pleased.
The light is easy to install, and provides a significant number of choices for the wave length and brightness of the light.  People have subsequently  commented on my jewelry, make-up, and picture quality- but none have realized it is just a little bit of light.  It truly is like magic.  I have a window behind my desk chair that at certain times of day would cause an issue with my on screen image - no more.  If you spend anytime on web can you owe it to yourself to try out a light.  I highly recommend this item.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Works well, but just not bright enough and a bit overpriced
reviews.comment:
I bought this to help with lighting while in Zoom meetings working from home.
This thing works pretty well, but it just isn't bright enough for my use case. If the room is dark or there's not a huge amount of ambient light coming in from windows or if you're sitting much closer to it, this will probably work well for you. But in my south-facing office, forget it. It just cannot overpower the significant backlighting that results in this situation. I ended up going with the Dazzne 2-pack with the desk clamps (https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B07T593JR5), which works super well.
The switch on the cord is handy, but awkward as you need to be sure to position it just right.
Overall it seems to be a bit overpriced for what you get.
reviews.author: Dennis

reviews.title: Gets the job done, some draw backs...
reviews.comment:
Love the light, and provides good and even lighting. I like that I can just plug it in to my PC and start streaming, and since it is USB I can use my smart phone wall plug to use a wall outlet instead.
That being said, when using the webcam mount, it doesn't lock in properly. If my table wobbles or I have to readjust the camera, it will fall right out of the ring light. I could probably fix it with a very small piece of tape, but I wish they just made a snap-in feature so it was secure.
Another minor thing is that I wish there were drivers or some software with this so I can control the light on my computer rather than the small switch, as I have to reach under my desk. This however is a very minor thing that is opinion based.
Overall it is a good product and gets the job done. I love how there are different tones of lighting and I can adjust the brightness from extremely dim to bright.
